title: E0135: PHP info disclosure
plain_english: Calling `phpinfo()` in committed code exposes detailed PHP configuration and environment information.
why_matters: `phpinfo()` output can reveal: - PHP version, loaded extensions, and server configuration - Environment variables and configuration values - Information that helps attackers identify version-specific weaknesses and plan targeted attacks
good_example:
// Remove phpinfo() entirely from production code.
// Use it only in local development and do not commit it.
what_it_checks: `phpinfo()` function calls anywhere in committed source code
